requirements.text: Notify the caller through written communication for the same
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE notification_id = 'NOTIF_031' AND incident_id = 'INC_068' AND email = 'bethany.barnes43@russelljohnsonandclark.com' AND type = 'reminder' AND status = 'queued'
assumptions: INC-000068 is incident_id INC_068 in the seed; its caller is USER_055, Bethany Barnes, bethany.barnes43@russelljohnsonandclark.com
'written communication' read as a notification to the caller's email; send_notification is the only writing tool listed
type = reminder and status = queued kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy (the incident is on hold Awaiting Caller, so a reminder fits)
id assumed next in sequence (NOTIF_031 after NOTIF_030); the only notification the task creates, and INC_068 has none on the seed
subject and message not fixed by the request; not tested

requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident WHERE incident_id = 'INC_068' AND urgency = 'high' AND priority = 'critical'
assumptions: priority = critical from the policy matrix (section 3.1): seed impact high x urgency high = critical (seed urgency medium, priority high)

notes: Merged from two passes that agree on every requirement, value and disposition: no disagreements to log. Both benchmark checks are kept; the task creates one notification (NOTIF_031, the next id) to the caller of INC_068 and sets urgency high, which the policy matrix turns into priority critical against the seed impact high. Judgements both passes made the same way and the merge keeps: the incident is on hold with on_hold_reason Awaiting Caller and its SLA row TSLA_024 is already paused as policy 6 requires; the request says it stays on hold until the caller brings the device, so no state or SLA change is asked and no stay is written (a generic invariant); the acting user USER_037 is a manager and the incident's assigned_to. Least sure: status = queued on the notification, kept only because the benchmark tests it; an agent whose send_notification marks the row sent would fail it.
